create_LAMA_dataset: create a LAMA dataset instance for a specific subset like trex or conceptnet
load_LAMA_dataset: load a HuggingFace LAMA dataset by subset name using the load_dataset method
split_train_test_lines: split the LAMA training data into train and test sets using get_train_test_lines
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace LAMA dataset split to a list of input-output tuples
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot few-shot data splits for a LAMA subset with a given seed
